verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS data-enrichment platform, but the evidence shows no way to self-host Riveter's core enrichment engine. The only local component is an MCP connector that "runs on your machine" yet still needs an API key to reach the hosted service. That is an adjacent client bridge, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
